Barbithrix is a human warlock, or something close to those descriptors, in service of the Strife Emperor at Rybad-Kol in the closing days of the Calamity. As an NPC, he is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan. Casimir and Marsa were followers of the Moonweaver living during the last days of the Calamity, and the parents of Rei'nia Saph. Celdria was a blue female dragonborn child held (with her mother Celeste and brother Celwyn) in Rybad-Kol prison as of the final battle of the Calamity. As an NPC, was played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

page.overview:
Who is Rei'nia Saph?

is a half-elf nurse and cleric played by Celia Rose Gooding in Exandria Unlimited: Divergence.

Rei'nia was young, with dark brown skin and silver white locs that she tried to keep from fusing. She saw herself as very observant, and tried to hide her intense hope that things would someday be different while keeping the workers functional as long as possible. She was naive enough to believe that she knew better than those who had been beaten down by years of experience.

In the years following the Divergence she became more confident, left her hair grow slightly longer, and started wearing silver, white, and blue clothes.

Rei'nia grew up during the Calamity with her younger sister Liana. They were both friends of Luz, a tiefling that shared stories about Sehanine the Moonweaver, causing them to develop their own personal beliefs connected to the goddess and Catha.
